Remark
[Covariant derivative and curvature acting on one-forms] ↗ def:riemann-curvature-tensor

For one-forms, $\nabla _{\partial _r}dx^k=-\Gamma ^k_{rl}dx^l$ and $\Rm (\partial _i,\partial _j)dx^k=-{{R_{ij}}^k}_l dx^l$; consequently $\Delta X_i-\Ric _{ik}X^k=-\Delta _dX_i$.
